instr: Picture analogies: the first picture changes into the second; pick the picture that changes the third one in the same way.
clue: The top picture on the left changes into the one on its right. Find the option that changes the lower picture in exactly the same way (it may turn, flip, change fill, change size or gain a copy, or two of these). Click or tap the option, or press its number key 1-4. Press Start when ready.
